pairs: Et factus est sermo Domini ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me,
and pour in drops toward the sanctuaries,
and prophesy against the soil of Israel.
And you shall say to the land of Israel:
et ejiciam gladium meum de vagina sua,
and I will cast my sword from its sheath,
and I will slay the just and the impious among you.
Pro eo autem quod occidi in te justum et impium,
But in as much as I have slain among you the just and the impious,
idcirco egredietur gladius meus de vagina sua ad omnem carnem,
for this reason my sword will go forth from its sheath against all flesh,
from the south even to the north.
ut sciat omnis caro quia ego Dominus,
So may all flesh know that I, the Lord,
eduxi gladium meum de vagina sua irrevocabilem.
have led my sword out of its sheath irrevocably.
groan in the breaking of your back,
et in amaritudinibus ingemisce coram eis.
and groan in bitterness before them.
And when they will say to you,
And every heart will waste away,
and every hand will be broken,
and every spirit will be weakened,
et per cuncta genua fluent aquæ:
and water will flow across every knee.’
it is approaching and it will happen,
Et factus est sermo Domini ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me,
so that it may cut down victims!
You are disturbing the scepter of my son.
You have cut down every tree.
And I have sent it to be made smooth,
so that it may be handled.
so that it may be in the hand of the one who kills.
quia hic factus est in populo meo,
For this has been done among my people,
hic in cunctis ducibus Israël qui fugerant:
this is among all the leaders of Israel, who have fled.
gladio traditi sunt cum populo meo:
They have been handed over to the sword,
with my people. Therefore, slap your thigh,
when he will have overthrown the scepter,
and let the sword be doubled,
and let the sword of the slain be tripled.
This is the sword of the great slaughter,
which causes them to be utterly stupefied,
and to waste away in heart,
and which multiplies ruin. At all their gates,
In omnibus portis eorum dedi conturbationem gladii acuti,
I have presented the consternation of the sword, which has been sharpened and polished so as to shine,
et limati ad fulgendum, amicti ad cædem.
which has been dressed for the slaughter.
vade ad dexteram sive ad sinistram,
Go to the right or to the left,
whichever way is the desire of your face.
Quin et ego plaudam manu ad manum,
And then I will clap hand against hand,
and I will fulfill my indignation.
Et factus est sermo Domini ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me,
“And as for you, son of man,
so that the sword of the king of Babylon may approach.
Both shall go forth from one land.
And with a hand, he will grasp and cast lots;
he will cast at the head of the way of the community.
Viam pones ut veniat gladius ad Rabbath filiorum Ammon,
You shall appoint a way, so that the sword may approach to Rabbah of the sons of Ammon,
et ad Judam in Jerusalem munitissimam.
or to Judah, into Jerusalem, greatly fortified.
Stetit enim rex Babylonis in bivio,
For the king of Babylon stood at the fork,
at the head of the two ways,
Ad dexteram ejus facta est divinatio super Jerusalem,
To his right was set the divination over Jerusalem,
ut ponat arietes, ut aperiat os in cæde,
to place battering rams so as to open a mouth for the slaughter,
to lift up the voice of wailing,
to place battering rams opposite the gates,
Eritque quasi consulens frustra oraculum in oculis eorum,
And he shall be, in their eyes, like someone consulting an oracle in vain,
or imitating the leisure of Sabbaths.
ipse autem recordabitur iniquitatis ad capiendum.
But he will call to mind iniquities, so that it will be captured.
Therefore, thus says the Lord God:
Pro eo quod recordati estis iniquitatis vestræ,
Because you have been remembered in your iniquities,
and you have revealed your betrayals,
et apparuerunt peccata vestra in omnibus cogitationibus vestris,
and your sins have appeared within all your plans,
you have been remembered, you will be captured by a hand.
cujus venit dies in tempore iniquitatis præfinita:
whose day has arrived that was predetermined at the time of iniquity:
nonne hæc est quæ humilem sublevavit,
Is this not what has exalted the lowly one,
and brought low the sublime one?
et hoc non factum est, donec veniret cujus est judicium,
And this was not done until the one arrived to whom judgment belongs,
and I will hand it over to him.
Hæc dicit Dominus Deus ad filios Ammon,
Thus says the Lord God to the sons of Ammon,
unsheathe yourself so as to slay;
polish yourself so as to kill and to shine,
while they look upon you in vain,
ut dareris super colla vulneratorum impiorum,
so that you may be given over to the necks of the wounded impious,
quorum venit dies in tempore iniquitatis præfinita.
whose day has arrived that was predetermined at the time of iniquity.
in loco in quo creatus es:
I will judge you in the place where you were created,
in terra nativitatis tuæ judicabo te.
in the land of your nativity.
Et effundam super te indignationem meam;
And I will pour out upon you my indignation.
in igne furoris mei sufflabo in te:
In the fire of my fury, I will fan you,
daboque te in manus hominum insipientium,
and I will give you over to the hands of cruel men,
You will be food for the fire;
sanguis tuus erit in medio terræ;
your blood will be in the midst of the land;
you will be delivered to oblivion.
For I, the Lord, have spoken.”
